programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Halloween Scene
programme.desc: When Sabrina can’t find anyone to share her enthusiasm for Halloween she decides to throw her own haunted holiday bash and it turns into the party of the year.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Welcome Traveler
programme.desc: When Sabrina tries to pull Miles away from his latest conspiracy theory and into some semblance of a social life, she unknowingly pushes him right into the hands of a cult whose eccentric leader claims to be a witch.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Some of My Best Friends are Half-Mortals
programme.desc: Tired of hiding her true identity when dating mortal guys, Sabrina agrees to be fixed up by Zelda with a handsome and charming witch, Derek. The budding romance is dashed when she encounters racism over the fact that she is half-mortal.
programme.sub-title: Some of My Best Friends are Half-Mortals

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Lost @ C
programme.desc: Sabrina is distraught when she receives her first “C” ever on a class assignment and turns to Zelda for counseling. Zelda ends up conducting her own private tutoring session with Sabrina’s handsome professor.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s Perfect Christmas
programme.desc: Sabrina opts to spend a picture-perfect Christmas with Morgan and her family rather than endure the annual insanity with Hilda and Zelda. She soon discovers the ugly secrets under the flawless façade.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: My Best Shot
programme.desc: Sabrina tries to give Josh a little confidence booster in his new passion to be a photographer, but her simple spell to help him make his first sale leads to his getting a big head and walking out on his job at the coffeehouse.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Tick-Tock Hilda’s Clock
programme.desc: When Sabrina throws Hilda a surprise party for her 650th birthday, Hilda becomes depressed that she doesn’t have a husband or family yet. Things go from bad to worse when Sabrina loses the out-of-whack biological clock.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s New Roommate
programme.desc: When Sabrina reluctantly takes in Zelda for a few days while Hilda’s on a home remodeling binge, Sabrina and her roommates try to loosen up her uptight Aunt Zelda.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Making the Grade
programme.desc: Sabrina tries to right a wrong when she writes an article for the school paper exposing the preferential treatment given to school athletes, but she inadvertently puts Roxie's scholarship in jeopardy.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Love is a Many Complicated Thing
programme.desc: Sabrina agrees to a double date on Valentine's Day with Josh and Morgan, but by the end of the date she finds herself in the middle of her friends' break up.
programme.sub-title: Love is a Many Complicated Thing

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina the Muse
programme.desc: Sabrina is flattered when her new boyfriend writes music about his feelings for her, but the pressure to inspire him as his muse becomes a one-sided relationship.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Beach Blanket Bizarro
programme.desc: Sabrina’s wild visions of her first college spring break turn squeaky-clean when her aunts ask 60’s teen idol Frankie Avalon to put a spell on the trip. This sends Sabrina and her friends into a world straight out of a 60’s beach movie.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Witchright Hall
programme.desc: When Sabrina’s trouble-making teenage cousin Amanda is sent to live with Hilda and Zelda, they count on Sabrina to convince the headmaster and school director of Witchright Hall to accept Amanda.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina the Activist
programme.desc: Sabrina, who is now in low spirits over her heavy course load and recent break up, decides to put her energy into something positive: leading a protest to save an historical building from demolition.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Do You See What I See?
programme.desc: Sabrina feels responsible when Miles considers giving up his paranormal research to settle in his father’s accounting business after no one believes the otherworldly phenomena he sees at the Spellman home.
programme.sub-title: Do You See What I See?

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s Got Spirit
programme.desc: Sabrina tries to throw off Miles and the specialist he has hired to uncover paranormal activity in the house, but Sabrina herself discovers a ghost in the ceiling.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Finally!
programme.desc: Romance brews between Sabrina and Josh when they turn the coffeehouse into a single's night featuring entertainment by the band Eden's Crush.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Really Big Season Opener
programme.desc: Miles decides to make a student film in his favorite genre, horror, and enlists Sabrina as the producer of his film.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s Date with Destiny
programme.desc: Sabrina and her friends return to school and a lot of excitement after summer break.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: What’s News?
programme.desc: Josh lands a job as a photojournalist for the Boston Citizen, and is surprised to learn that Sabrina is a fan of his new boss, Mike Shelby.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Murder on the Halloween Express
programme.desc: Hilda and Zelda are invited to attend a murder mystery party on the Halloween Mystery Train, which makes a stop in Boston.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Gift of Gab
programme.desc: Sabrina and Roxie are thrilled to get their own show on the campus radio station, a two hour talk show they call "Chick Chat."

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Thin Ice
programme.desc: Sabrina finds herself in a jam when ex-boyfriend Harvey requests that she use her magical powers to help him.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Hex, Lies, and No Videotape
programme.desc: Josh gets Sabrina an internship at the Boston Citizen where he works.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Humble Pie
programme.desc: Sabrina and her roommates discover that Morgan didn't pay her portion of the rent when the housing office sends a student to replace her in the house.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: A Birthday Witch
programme.desc: Sabrina receives an unexpected surprise on her birthday, a visit from her evil Aunt Irms, the matriarch of the Spellman family.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Deliver Us from Email
programme.desc: Intern Sabrina wants to propose writing her own column about the college experience to Boston Citizen editor Mike Shelby.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Cloud Ten
programme.desc: In an attempt to escape her problems, Sabrina decides to visit her childhood friend, Cathy Winter (Colleen Ann Fitzpatrick) in the Other Realm.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina and the Candidate
programme.desc: Sabrina is assigned to research the local city councilman election for an article, which will run in the Boston Citizen.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: I Think I Love You
programme.desc: Sabrina's relationship with Josh couldn't be going better until Josh tells her that he loves her.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Arrangement
programme.desc: Sabrina's devilish Aunt Irma returns for yet another unexpected visit.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Time After Time
programme.desc: When Zelda's boyfriend breaks up with her she cooks up a storm to drown her sorrows.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina and the Kiss
programme.desc: Sabrina gets an unexpected surprise when ex-boyfriend Derek stops by to say hello.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Competition
programme.desc: A friendly game of tennis turns into a battle of the sexes when Josh tells Sabrina that women are not as competitive as men.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: I, Busybody
programme.desc: Always willing to help others with their problems, whether they ask for it or not, Sabrina finds herself in a heap of trouble when her advice goes awry.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Guilty
programme.desc: When Sabrina uses a little magic to get Zelda nominated for an award, she has no idea what she's started.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Whole Ball of Wax
programme.desc: When Sabrina gets an eerie feeling that she is being followed, she decides to take matters into her own hands but ends up face-to-face with her mother Diana.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Driving Mr. Goodman
programme.desc: Sabrina persuades Miles Goodman to get his driver's license and finds herself in the middle of a nasty lawsuit.

programme.title: Mitt navn er fortsatt Nobody
programme.desc: Den sjarmerende og dovne svindler og revolversvinger Joe Thanks - også kaldt "Nobody" - reiser som en annen gjøgler fra by til by og opptrer i mer eller mindre realistiske revolverdueller.

programme.title: To helskrudde agenter
programme.desc: Rosco lurer fengselsfuglen Doug til å banke opp noen trailersjåfører som har presset ham av veien. I desperasjon tar de flyet på Miami, men nå tror alle at de er CIA-agenter.

programme.title: Vi holder med flodhestene
programme.desc: En av Terence Hill og Bud Spencers aller største suksesser – og det sier ikke lite.

programme.title: Gi' den hele armen
programme.desc: Radarparet Bud Spencer og Terrence Hill har forlatt Ville vesten for et mer moderne miljø. Pilotene Plata og Salud har en jobb utenom det vanlige - ett av oppdragene slår feil og de krasjer i Amazonas' jungel, midt blant råbarkede diamant-tyver.

programme.title: Vestens hardeste neve
programme.desc: I en liten, nedslitt prærieby har Colorada Slim og ganden han overtatt kontrollen. Buddy og indianervennen Cocoa besøker byen, og dessverre for Slim og banden han forstyrrer de Buddy - mens han spiser. Og det kan gjøre Buddy sint - meget sint!

programme.title: Sammen er vi kaos
programme.desc: I Miami begår politiet en utrolig brøler ved å ansette Wilbur Walsh (Spencer) og Matt Kirby (Hill) som patruljerende politiassistenter. Deres utradisjonelle arbeidsmetoder vekker begeistring, selv om de gang på gang prøver å bli kastet ut.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Bud Spencer er Banana Joe, en vennlig kjempe av en banandyrker som bor i en liten Søramerikansk by. Det går livet sin vante gang helt til et stort selskap vil ta over bananplantasjen og sette Joe i fengsel.

programme.title: Skurker og banditter
programme.desc: Tony Roma er tidenes sleipeste gigolo, en skøyer som tar det meste på sparket, spesialisert på å rappe rike husmødres diamanter. Til slutt kobles den hemmelige politimannen Parker inn for endelig å få fakket gigoloen.

programme.title: Jo mere vi er sammen
programme.desc: Løytnant Firpo har som hemmelig oppdrag å bekjempe et gambling-syndikat på USA's østkyst. Hans halvbror Charlie er en forhenværende gambler som kjenner alle knepe. Han går motvillig med på å hjelpe Johnny, og sammen renser de opp i Miamis underverden.

programme.desc: What begins as a simple home burglary evolves into a very strange series of events for professional thief Kevin Gilliam.

programme.desc: The church choir hits a sour note when parishioner Wally McDaniels, is accused of murder. McDanielsturns to fellow choir member Ben Matlock to prove his innocence.

programme.desc: Amidst the beauty of a luxurious island mansion, a mystery game for charity quickly evolves into a puzzling murder when Matlock discovers the victim is really dead!

programme.desc: A budding friendship between two great lawyers blossoms into animosity when Matlock and District Attorney Brennen square off on a murder trial. Not only does Matlock believe in his client’s innocence, he thinks Brennen might be the one who’s guilty!

programme.title: Matlock: The Pi

programme.title: Matlock: The Scandal

programme.title: Matlock: Deadly Dose

programme.title: South Park: Mer drittproblemer
programme.desc: Randy slår verdensrekorden 'største bæsj', og den tidligere rekordinnehaveren Bono vil ha tilbake tronen. Men han har en mørk hemmelighet som kanskje kan hindre ham.

programme.title: South Park: Britneys nye stil
programme.desc: Mediesirkuset kommer til South Park når Britney gjemmer seg i den avsidesliggende fjellbyen. Guttene prøver å hjelpe den plagede popstjernen.

programme.title: South Park: Kina-problemet
programme.desc: Cartman blir forskrekket over den storslåtte OL-seremonien og ber Butters om hjelp til å konfrontere kineserne. Samtidig blir Stan og Kyle vitne til 'voldtekten' av Indiana Jones.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med den nye kjæresten sin til en Jonas Brothers-konsert der de får kyskhetsringer.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskepikker
programme.desc: Jimmi er rasende for at Cartmann prøver å ta æren for en vits som han fant på og som nå er blitt populær i hele landet. Men en sint Kanye West klarer ikke å forstå poenget.

programme.title: South Park: Døde kjendiser
programme.desc: Michael Jacksons spøkelse nekter å akseptere å måtte vandre heden og etterlater resten av de nylig avdøde berømtheter frustrert i Skjærsilden.

programme.title: South Park: Sexhjelpen
programme.desc: Kyle og Butters befinner seg midt blant Amerikas superkjendiser når de gjennomgår en behandling for sexavhengighet. Cartman og Stan er limt til Tiger Woods-kampen.

programme.title: South Park: Lattermaskinen
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt gjort narr av på The South Park Elementary Comedy Awards, bygger Germany en uovervinnerlig lattermaskin: Funnybot. Men dens planer for menneskeheten går likevel ikke altfor bra.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman finner kjærligheten
programme.desc: Cartman spiller matchmaker når en ny jente flytter til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Kravene heves
programme.desc: Cartman innrømmer endelig at han er feit og får umiddelbart en permobil.

programme.title: South Park: Hobbiten
programme.desc: Wendy prøver å pare en av sine venninner med Butters, men hun ender opp på kontoret til skolekuratoren.

programme.title: South Park: #Oppkok
programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spill med lillebroren sin. Men da Ike vil ikke spille med ham mer, blir Kyle redd for at neste generasjon vil forbigå ham.

programme.title: South Park: Glade hologram
programme.desc: Cartman trender, mens resten av USA forbereder seg til det største juleprogrammet på tv noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Fabuløs og modig
programme.desc: Gutta viser Caitlyn Jenner sin enormt store respekt i det mest fabuløse og modige 'South Park'-avsnittet noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Trygt sted
programme.desc: Cartman er siste offer innen kroppsskam.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Den nye gutten i klassen overtaler Jesus til å kjempe mot Satan, i det endelige oppgjøret mellom godt og ondt. Cartman blir rasende når han oppdager at oppgjøret krasjer med bursdagsfesten hans.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans mor er en hore
programme.desc: Dr. Mephisto hjelper Cartman med å avsløre farens identitet, og alle mannlige innbyggere i South Park er aktuelle kandidater.

programme.title: South Park: Byen ved avgrunnens rand (tilbakeblikk)
programme.desc: Skolebussen krasjer i en snøstorm og blir stående på kanten av et stup.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef prøver å kreve royalties da et plateselskap slipper en låt han hevder han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny blir oppslukt av det siste nye fra Japan: Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle trenger nyretransplantasjon og Cartman er den perfekte donor, men setter en høy pris for nyren: 10 millioner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer nabolaget
programme.desc: Token føler seg ensom fordi han er eneste rike barn i byen, og lokker andre velstående mennesker til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmtraileren
programme.desc: Alle barna i South Park er superspente på å se den første traileren for den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmen.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS stands for terror and the murder of millions. Documentary about the history of a symbol that represents murder.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”, the biggest aircraft in WWII.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson and the judges begin their search by holding auditions in Glasgow and London

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson and the judges Grace Woodward, Julien Macdonald and Charley Speed continue their UK tour, in Cardiff and Birmingham. They audition more girls hoping to make it in the world of modelling.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Grace Woodward, Julien Macdonald and Charley Speed judge the final round of auditions, giving hopefuls one last chance to secure a place at the boot camp

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls who have made it through the audition stage battle it out in boot camp. Twelve girls will be chosen to move into the house and the next stage of the competition.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls face their first challenge after moving into the house and learn there will be a double elimination this week. Janice Dickinson helps decide who will be the first two girls eliminated from the competition.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The models are given complete makeovers before posing nude for a photo shoot. George Lamb joins the judging panel this week.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls have to pose with different birds of prey and tensions there ends up being tension between some of the girls. Jasmine Guinness joins the judging panel to decide who will be eliminated this week.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The models go one-on-one interviews with The Wanted but for some girls the mistakes just keep coming. Fashion designer Henry Holland joins the judges at panel and it becomes time to rise and smize or become a catwalk casualty.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The seven remaining girls face another double elimination this week and find themselves being thrown in at the deep end. Katie Price joins the judges on the panel this week.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The final five girls left in the running complete in a beauty shoot before preparing to fly off to Miami. In a dramatic turn of events one of the girls is left behind and her place in the contest becomes uncertain.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: In Miami, the top four girls must try their hands at acting, before shaking their pompoms and becoming brides for the day

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: It's the penultimate week of the contest, and four girls remain. The quartet attend 'go sees' and complete the last photo shoot of the series. Who will make the final?

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: From thousands of hopefuls, just two remain to battle it out on the catwalk. Who will Elle Macpherson crown as Britain & Ireland's Next Top Model?

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 1
programme.desc: The show returns for an eighth series with 20 contestants all competing to impress judges Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford, Whitney Port and Julien Macdonald to win a contract with Models 1.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 2
programme.desc: The remaining 17 contestants meet with the judges for one-on-one interviews and are scheduled to have a photo shoot with camels in the desert, but it gets canceled due to a sandstorm.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 3
programme.desc: The 13 contestants move into the model house and have a housewarming party, where they are visited by Cycle 7 winner Jade Thompson.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 4
programme.desc: The remaining 12 contestants receive makeovers at the Daniel Galvin salon and get their teeth whitened before being treated to a day out at a skating disco.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 5
programme.desc: The contestants go to the Hurlingham Academy and meet image consultant Vernon Francois for a challenge in which they decorate t-shirts and talk about their insecurities in a motivational speech for the school's students.

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Etter møtet med Cora Van Husen, får Krystle en kopi av den skandaløse videoen som beviser at Blake er uskyldig.

programme.desc: Sean utnytter Alexis' forsøk på å bli guvernør til å ta kontroll over Colbyco. Sammy Jo og Jeff er begge ensomme og utvikler et dypt vennskap. Dana forteller Adam at han var far til hennes aborterte barn.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle får ødeleggende opplysninger om Alexis' ekteskap med Cecil Colby. Leslie følger etter Sean til farens grav og får vite at han egentlig er Joseph Aynders sønn.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Adam og Fallon stemmer, og Steven må motvillig godta Vitron-oljehandelen, og Seans vanvittige plan for å hevne farens død settes i verk.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis får stor offentlig støtte etter skytingen, og det oppmuntrer henne til å fortsette valgkampen. Sean setter fortgang i planene om utnytte Vitron-handelen for å knuse Alexis.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sean er lei av Leslies trusler om å avsløre hvem han egentlig er, og gjemmer en giftig slange på rommet hennes for å advare henne om hvem hun står overfor.

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.desc: Etter eksplosjonen i Natumbre blir Blake anklaget for ulovlig våpenhandel. Alexis finner bevis på at Sean betalte Jesse for å komme tilbake til Denver, for at han skulle overtale Karen til å beholde Adams baby.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dana prøver desperat å overbevise Adam om hvor inderlig hun vil ha sønnen deres. Hun foreslår at hvis de fremstår som et sammensveiset par igjen, vil dommeren dømme i deres favør.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Adam blir fritatt for mistanke om at han har kidnappet sønnen sin når Leslie forteller ham at Sean har tatt babyen og holder henne fanget.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Etter Seans død, finner Alexis trøst i Dex' vennskap, og de blåser liv i lidenskapen igjen.

programme.desc: Blake nyter tiden sammen med Krystle i Dayton, og er fortsatt forvirret over hukommelsessvikten hennes, og frykter at det skal skje igjen.

programme.title: Dating Naked UK

programme.title: Dating Naked UK

programme.desc: On a planet about to crown its new monarch. The problem is the Princess cannot ascend unless she finds a genetically compatible mate.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E11 - Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E12 - Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programme.desc: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter the crown princess, or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E12 - Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E13 - Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programme.desc: John Crichton faces eighty years as a statue. That is, until the Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into a vat of acid.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E13 - Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E14 - Beware Of Dog
programme.desc: The crew bring aboard an alien tracker to remove some creatures that came aboard hidden in some cargo.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E14 - Beware Of Dog

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E15 - Won't Get Fooled Again
programme.desc: Crichton has returned to Earth. Or has he always been on Earth all this time? People from his past and present appear.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E15 - Won't Get Fooled Again

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E16 - The Locket
programme.desc: A temporal distortion traps Aeryn and John on a planet's surface, where they live out the rest of their lives.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E17 - The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: Crais and Talyn return. The crew are put on trial for an attack that Talyn made on an alien ship.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E17 - The Ugly Truth

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E18 - A Clockwork Nebari
programme.desc: A Nebari group comes aboard Moya and attempts to mind cleanse everyone using a drug. Pilot and Rygel are the only two who can resist the effects.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E18 - A Clockwork Nebari

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E19 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 1: A Not So Simple Plan
programme.desc: D'Argo finally gets a lead on his son, Jothee. He will do anything to get him back, but Jothee will be sold as a slave.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E19 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 1: A Not So Simple Plan

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E20 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 2: With Friends Like These
programme.desc: With the loot from the Depository heist at hand, D'Argo anxiously waits to make contact with the Slave Traders.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E20 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 2: With Friends Like These

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E21 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
programme.desc: The crew is going to break into the depository to free Crichton. Crichton is being tortured for wormhole technology.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E21 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E22 - Die Me, Dichotomy
programme.desc: Wealthy from their bank heist, Moya's crew heads straight to meet with Diagnosan Tocot, a famous surgeon whom they hope can heal Moya's burns.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E22 - Die Me, Dichotomy

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E1 - Season Of Death
programme.desc: D'Argo and Stark try to heal John, left with his head open on an operating table, while Scorpius attempts to avoid discovery.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E1 - Season Of Death

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E2 - Suns And Lovers
programme.desc: Moya docks at a commerce station so the crew can spend some of their money. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E2 - Suns And Lovers

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E3 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.desc: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in and fused to another ship.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E3 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E4 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.desc: The crew works out a way of getting free from the other ship and out of the wormhole.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E4 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E5 - Different Destinations
programme.desc: Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, Aeryn. D'Argo and Jool are back in time where they alter the timeline.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: After realizing Tom knows he is promicin-positive, Kyle joins Jordan in a remote town called Evanston. Tom follows Kyle, and learns the remarkable truth about Evanston: all of its residents are promicin-positive.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for Curtis Peck, a 4400 film maker whose ability allows him to `know` the truth behind historical conspiracies. Jordan tries to recruit Shawn into his movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Jordan and his followers annex a run-down part of Seattle, dubbing it `Promise City`. Shawn's campaign for city council is threatened when a woman accuses him of using his healing ability in exchange for sex.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A lockdown at NTAC threatens the lives of Tom, Diana, Meghan, Shawn, Kyle, Jordan, Isabelle, Maia, Marco, PJ and Brady when they wakeup inside the building with no recollection of how they got there.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps Isabelle from Collier's Promise City. Richard hopes to start a new life with his daughter. Elsewhere, Tess has taken over a 1950's diner, and Shawn is asked to intervene.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The Director of National Intelligence pressures NTAC to pursue Richard and Isabelle. Richard is visited by his dead wife, Lily.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A computer virus attacks a large software company owned by a suspected member of The Marked. Maia visits Promise City and receives an unexpected birthday gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Isabelle works with Tom in order to get close to Jordan. Shawn recruits a small band of promicin positives to break Kevin out of Promise City. Tom and Diana face off in the backroom of a grocery store, and Diana is forced to shoot Tom.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Danny Farrell's newfound ability to spread promicin leads to several hundred deaths, including his mother. With Seattle in chaos, NTAC is forced to accept Promise City's offer of help.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A comet is due to pass by Earth, but its trajectory changes to a collision course, causing widespread panic. When the comet appears to slow down - as if it's coming in for a landing - 4,400 people are deposited in an explosion over Highland Beach.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 returnees have been missing from months to years. None have any memory of where they've been, none have aged, and a small number are beginning to manifest paranormal abilities. Tom Baldwin and Diana Skouris are appointed to investigate.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Carl Morrissey is a lowly supermarket employee who happens to be one of the 4400. He uses his new found powers - enhanced reflexes and strength - to become a vigilante and fight crime in his neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: The New and Improved Carl Morrissey

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are sent out to investigate a homicide that resembles the MO of a serial killer who was never caught nor heard of for 21 years. The first suspect is Oliver Knox, a member of the 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 are attacked by a series of bombings after Barbara Yates makes their names and addresses known to the public. Tom, Diana and Dennis try to put an end to the bombings, while at the same time Tom is coping with Kyle's erratic behaviour.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom is furious after finding out that Lytell has taken his son Kyle into custody. Diana offers to help him in getting Kyle back. Meanwhile, Richard suspects that Collier is trying to take control of Lily's life.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro, a minor league baseball player, finds that he is hearing everyone's unspoken thoughts. His new found ability quickly drives him to the edge of madness.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Trent Appelbaum, a 4400 whose saliva causes rapid acceleration of a person's metabolism.

programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: Andromeda: Alldeles för mänsklig
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka och Trance följer med Rommie för att ta reda på om ett vapen som utvecklas på en planet som misstror AI.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una Salus Victus
programme.desc: Andromeda har till uppgift att eskortera medicinska skepp på ett säkert sätt genom Drago-Kazovs rymd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hemmabränder
programme.desc: En planet med överlevande från Samväldet som leds av Dylans före detta fästmö bjuds in att ansluta sig till det nya Samväldet.

programme.title: Andromeda: In i labyrinten
programme.desc: En agent från Abyss försöker locka Harper att ansluta sig till Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen
programme.desc: När de räddar en ung prins från ett uppror som dödar resten av hans familj blir Dylan och Tyr ombedda att bli hans rådgivare.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunkernkulle
programme.desc: Dylan och hans nya flotta från Samväldet tar sig an Drago-Kazovs flotta men finner den mycket större än väntat.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ouroboros
programme.desc: Magog-äggen i Harper börjar kläckas, så teamet bygger en Teseract-maskin.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lava och raketer
programme.desc: Dylan tar över en turistbåt i ett försök att undkomma legosoldater.

programme.title: Andromeda: Var alla mina synder ihåg
programme.desc: En identifiering av en kropp går snett när det visar sig att Bekas tidigare besättningskamrat inte är död.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dans av majflugor
programme.desc: Andromeda räddar döende människor från en drivkraft, men de förvandlas snart till zombies som styrs av en hivemind.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himmelrik finns nu tre
programme.desc: Skapelsens motor kan skriva om universum enligt ägarens önskemål. Dylan, Beka och Trance måste få tag på den innan någon med mörka planer får tag på den.

programme.title: Andromeda: Saker som vi inte kan ändra på
programme.desc: Ett svart hål slår ut Dylan och skickar honom till en alternativ verklighet med fru och barn.
programme.sub-title: Saker som vi inte kan ändra på

programme.title: Andromeda: The Fair Uknown
programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en av de sedan länge försvunna grundarna av Samväldet, men upptäcker att hon kan vara mer besvärlig än vad hon är värd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Odjurets mage
programme.desc: Ett mytologiskt rymdmonster försöker äta Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Riddaren, döden och djävulen
programme.desc: Dylan försöker befria en flotta av tillfångatagna skepp, men flottan är inte säker på att den vill bli befriad. Deras AI:er fruktar att nya kaptener kommer att förslava dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Obefläckad varseblivning
programme.desc: Geniter attackerar Tyrs fru och koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunneln i slutet av ljuset
programme.desc: Med femtio partier ombord är Dylan värd för undertecknandet av stadgan för det nya samväldet, men upptäcker snart att det finns inkräktare som är fast beslutna att stoppa undertecknandet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Om hjulet är fast
programme.desc: Beka och Tyr tas över av energin från en dimensionell tunnel. Dylan, Trance och Harper måste rädda dem innan de förstör skeppet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skärvor
programme.desc: Dylan blir anklagad för mord och måste rentvå sitt namn samtidigt som han hittar delarna till en vas som sägs ge ägaren "kosmos välsignelser".

programme.title: Andromeda: Galet att bli räddad
programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en grupp flyktingar, men upptäcker att de har utsatts för regeringsexperiment och är extremt instabila.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Att Hitta en Hit
programme.desc: När Max använder personliga uppgifter om Phoebe och Link i en sångtext för sitt band, orsakar han en brytning mellan dem. Samtidigt försöker Hank och Barb lära Billy och Nora en värdefull läxa.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Killen Som Älskar Grupparbete
programme.desc: Phoebe går med i den coola gruppen i ett skolarbete, men upptäcker att de inte vill jobba lika hårt som hon. Max tar Phoebes vanliga plats i hennes vänners grupp för att försöka åka snålskjuts medan de andra gör allt arbete.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Superbarnvakterna
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max verkar vara två vanliga tonårstvillingar, men de tillhör en familj superhjältar. Phoebe strävar efter att vara normal och använder sina krafter för att göra gott, men Max väljer den mörka sidan. Kan livet bli normalt för familjen?

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Middagsbjudning
programme.desc: Max planerar att sabotera middagen när Phoebe bjuder hem killen hon är kär i och hans familj för att imponera på dem, men när en oväntad gäst dyker upp måste Phoebe och Max samarbeta för att förhindra att kvällen förvandlas till en katastrof.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Betyg
programme.desc: Efter att ha ändrat sina betyg och flyttats upp till avancerad matte, får Max tävla mot Phoebe i 'Matteduellen'. Samtidigt försöker Hank, Nora och Billy att fånga den gäckande tidningstjuven.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe mot Max
programme.desc: När Max utsätter Phoebe för ett practical joke när de ska ta skolfoton utbryter ett practical joke-krig mellan dem som går överstyr. Samtidigt försöker sig Hank och Barb på en ny uppfostringsmodell för att få Billy och Nora att hjälpa till hemma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Knäpp Teknikmässa
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max låter sin gamla rivalitet blossa upp när de hjälper Billy och Nora med deras projekt för skolan teknikmässa. Under tiden försöker Barb ta Hank på bar gärning efter att han har kopierat hennes anteckningar för bokklubben.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Helggästen
programme.desc: Phoebe har anmält sig som frivillig för att ta hand om klassens Flugfälla över helgen, men när Max utför experiment på den, börjar den växa och hotar till slut att ta över hela huset.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Skolkdagen
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe använder sina krafter för att roa sig under Skolkdagen, men när de kommer på att det finns övervakningskameror på skolan tar de hjälp av Billy och Nora för att radera filmerna innan hemligheten avslöjas.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe är en Klon Nu
programme.desc: Efter att Phoebe tagit på sig alldeles för många aktiviteter, hjälper Max till genom att skapa en klon så att hon kan vara på två ställen samtidigt. När klonen börjar ställa till det för den riktiga Phoebe måste Max hjälpa till att rädda henes rykte.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Det här ser ut att vara ett job för
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe tar jobb på en pizzarestaurang för att få råd att köpa den nya mePhonen, och var för sig försöker de imponera på chefen med egna idéer. När Max tar på sig en för stor beställning måste de samarbeta för att rädda sina jobb.
programme.sub-title: Det här ser ut att vara ett job för

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Bli Knasig
programme.desc: En komet gör att Thundermans krafter blir knasiga samtidigt som killen Phoebe är kär i bjuder henne på skoldansen. Phoebe och Max får veta att om de håller ihop kan de hålla sina krafter i styr, men ingen är speciellt glad för att ha den andra nära.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Objudna Restauranggäster
programme.desc: När ungarna råkar krascha presenten som Hank köpt till Barb på deras bröllopsdag, måste de ta hjälp av Blobbin, en vän till familjen och superhjältemedhjälpare, för att laga den och se till att deras föräldrar inte får reda på nåt.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Brott Efter Brott
programme.desc: Hank bildar en brottsbekämpningsförening i grannskapet när det börjar begås brott. Max tar på sig skulden för brotten för att dölja sin egen hemlighet, men Phoebe vet att han är oskyldig och det är upp till familjen att fånga den verkliga brottslingen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Du Stal Min Dröm, Brorsan
programme.desc: När Max vinner skolvalet som Phoebe hade jobbat så hårt för, planerar hon sin hämnd.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thundersinne
programme.desc: Phoebe får förmågan att ana fara innan den har hänt, och använder sitt nyfunna sinne för att imponera på sina klasskamrater. Under tiden låtsas Max att han inte har fått sitt sinne ännu för att få presenter av Barb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Ha en Cool Födelsedag
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max vill få lov att hålla ett födelsedagsparty som normala tonåringar, men när en nedfryst fru Wong kommer bort och dom måste hitta henne, inser de hur bra deras familjepartyn faktiskt är.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Upp, upp och semester!
programme.desc: Familjen Thunderman deltar i en familjetävling för att vinna en drömsemester, men de har olika idéer om vart de ska åka. När de inte kan enas deltar de som två skilda lag, killar mot tjejer, och så får vinnaren bestämma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Inget är som ett pyjamasparty
programme.desc: Phoebe håller sitt första pyjamasparty och använder psykokinesi för att rädda det från att bli en katastrof. Som bestraffning måste hon ha på sig ett ankelband som hindrar henne från att använda sina krafter, så hon ber Max om hjälp.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Små Vita Körer
programme.desc: När en elak tjej vid namn Veronica saboterar för Phoebe i kören och utnyttjar Max genom att få honom att göra hennes läxor, samarbetar tvillingarna för att ta hämnd på henne.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kalla Doktorerna Thunderman
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe passar Billy och får ta honom till sjukhus när han skadar tummen. Efter att Max sett en nål och svimmat, måste de allihop se till att doktorerna inte ser röntgenbilderna av hans hjärna, för då kan hans superkrafter avslöjas.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kemi är Magi
programme.desc: Hank blir Max och Phoebes nya kemilärare. När han av en olyckshändelse äter kalkonmackor som får honom att somna så måste tvillingarna använda sina krafter för att hjälpa honom genomföra en presentation och behålla sitt jobb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fyra Superhjältar och en Bebis
programme.desc: Phoebe släpar med Billy och Nora till parken för att träffa killen hon är kär i och hans lilla lillebror, men när Max kommer för att hämta sina syskon tar han av misstag den riktiga bebisen i stället för Noras docka.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fult Spel i Hejaklacken
programme.desc: Phoebe och Cherrys vänskap sätts på prov när bara en av dem blir uttagen till cheerleader-laget. Max vinner en tävling där priset är en månads gratis pizza, och måste övertyga sin familj att han inte fuskade.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thunder-Van
programme.desc: Hank tar hem familjens Thunder-Van från Metroburg för att Phoebe ska kunna fortsätta sin superhjälteträning. När alla fyra barnen smyger sig in i bilen för att utan lov ta en tur ger Hank dem en åktur de aldrig kommer att glömma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Konsten att Sälja Konst
programme.desc: Phoebe får hjälp av Billy med ett konstprojekt, men får veta att han stulit föremålet från ett museum. Nu måste de samarbeta med Max för att ta sig in och lämna tillbaka det innan någon märker det.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Max hejdukar
programme.desc: Max låter några yngre elever bli hans hejdukar, men när de vänder på situationen och gör honom till offer för ett förödmjukande skämt, måste han tänka ut ett sätt att återta positionen som skolans värsting.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Jobbiga Föräldrar
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max är irriterade över familjens regler och använder en av Max apparater för att få Hank och Barb att bete sig som tonåringar. Men att då få ta över ansvaret som föräldrar får tonåringarna att ångra sig.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Strimligt
programme.desc: Phoebe blir förkrossad när hon tror att familjens nya dokumentförstörare av misstag förstört hennes konsertbiljetter till MKTO. I själva verket har Max tagit dem för att bjuda sin nya kärlek på konserten. Gästartister: Sidney Park och MKTO.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe Rockar
programme.desc: Phoebe försöker bli en tuff tjej för att imponera på Max nya bästa vän, en tuff rocker och frontfigur i Max nya band. Gästartist: Lizzie Green.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: En Dag i Gallerian
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max förvandlar en enkel tur till gallerian för att hämta Hanks födelsedagspresent till slagsmål, kaos och en kontrovers med vakten som hotar att förstöra deras pappas födelsedag.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Det Stora Fiaskot
programme.desc: Max vill försöka vinna en tävling för mest misslyckade video med en 'misslyckad' video med Phoebe när hon övar balett. När Phoebe får veta hans plan vägrar hon att samarbeta och Max tar till desperata åtgärder för att få de bilder han vill ha.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Vänner För Alltid
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max oroar sig för att de ska behöva umgås för jämnan när deras vänner börjar hänga med varandra. Syskonen tar till fula knep för att se till att det blir pinsamt för alla när de går på bio.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: De Hemsökta Thundermans Del 1
programme.desc: När en superskurk rymmer från Spökvärlden på Halloween, beger sig Thundermans till New Orleans för att tillsammans med Hathaways och Prestons besegra demonen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Mammas Superfan
programme.desc: Max och Phebe säljer av misstag några av Barbs gamla superhjältesaker till en superfan till Electress på familjens loppis, och måste skaffa tillbaka dem innan hon upptäcker det.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Råtta på Rymmen
programme.desc: Max förvandlar Billy till världens snabbaste råtta för att vinna råttävlingarna han har med killarna i bandet. Billy som fått smak på att springa med superfart bestämmer sig för att han inte vill bli människa igen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Ett vintrigt Thunderland
programme.desc: Max är som den värsta Scrooge strax innan jul, tills de förflutna, nuvarande och kommande jularnas andar dyker upp för att få honom i julstämning.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Evilmans
programme.desc: Det artar sig till en Romeo & Julia i supertappning när en pensionerad superskurk som råkar vara Thunder Mans gamla ärkefiende flyttar till Hiddenville, och hans son och Phoebe börjar träffa varandra i smyg.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Den Blåa Detektiven
programme.desc: När Max hud blir blå under en dejt blir alla misstänkta när han agerar superdetektiv för att finna den skyldiga.

programme.title: Just for Laughs GAGS
programme.desc: Dolda kameran med riktiga människor, livs levande actionkomedi! Njut av galenskapen från världens längst pågående och mest älskade skämtshow, där intet ont anande människor hamnar i lustiga situationer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: Soon after organizing a workers' strike, a union official is executed in his home. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood hear any gunshots. It takes a forensic sound test, an electron microscope and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder — that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All the World's a Stage
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bound for Jail
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nailed
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Zodiac
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to police and The New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people — one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Letter Perfect
programme.desc: A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

programme.title: Forensic Files: True Lies
programme.desc: In the summer of 1986, Kathleen Lipscomb's body was found on a deserted road outside of San Antonio. Months and years passed, but the crime was never solved. Finally, a private investigator discovered Kathleen's diary.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bed of Deceit
programme.desc: A retired police officer is found dead with a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife says the motive was robbery, but later tells police he committed suicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over and Out
programme.desc: When a pipe bomb rips through a rural home, police have no idea who is responsible. A 9-volt battery and the remnants of a mailing label ead investigators to the man who made the bomb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Death by a Salesman
programme.desc: No one in a quiet residential community saw anything unusual the day one of their neighbors was brutally attacked and murdered. Fingerprints found at the crime scene and surveillance video helped investigators to apprehend the presumed killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Web of Seduction
programme.desc: When investigators found Bruce Miller dead in the office of his junkyard business, the crime scene was almost pristine. But when a computer forensics expert examined computers owned by the victim's wife and her lover, he found all the evidence needed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grounds for Indictment
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.desc: Audrina träffar sin gamla flamma Corey igen och bollar plötsligt två killar. Spencer tvingar Heidi att sparka ut sin syster Holly från lägenheten.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren och Audrina åker till Cabo för Brodys födelsedag, men när Justin blir svartsjuk över Audrinas nya förhållande urartar festen i bråk. Spencer förödmjukar Stephanie när har får veta att hennes nya kille är kompis med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren försöker skipa fred mellan Brody och Stephanie. Audrina vill att det ska funka med Corey, men Justin vägrar ge upp. Stephanie undrar om hennes nya kille verkligen är nåt att ha när han bryter sitt löfte att stå på sig inför Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina flyttar till ett eget ställe i hopp om att Justin ska flytta ihop med henne, men alla är oroliga att hon flyttar av fel skäl. Heidi bjuder Spencer på ett jobbevenemang och ertappas på bar gärning med att ha lite för kul.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney reser till New York och förväntar sig att träffa Alex, men får i stället upp ögonen för Jay. Heidi är deppad över att ha fått sparken, men när Spencer går till Brent i ett försök att hjälpa henne få jobbet tillbaka gör han saken etter värre.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren låter Heidis syster sova över hos henne. Justin bjuder Audrina på en romantisk helgresa och Heidis frustration över Spencer växer när hon måste böna och be om att få jobbet tillbaka.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Thruple Trouble
programme.desc: Aubreys och Marks förhållande slår i botten. Devins nya romans gör att Marie flippar ur. Sista crushdejten utses och en oväntad gäst avbryter

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Two for One Deal
programme.desc: Coffey befinner sig mitt i Marks och Aubreys uppbrott. Mechie slits mellan sitt ex och sin nya kärlek vilket får Ariana att sitta på helspänn. Två ex skickas hem i dissceremonin.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Show Me the Receipts
programme.desc: En del bekanta och obekanta ansikten dyker upp för att röra om i grytan. Ett lögndetektortest tvingar vissa singlar att erkänna att de är struliga.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Final Crush
programme.desc: Huset måste brottas med resultatet från lögndetektortesterna. Singlarna måste fatta det ultimata beslutet. Kommer de att åka hem med exet, en ny kärlek eller ensamma?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion
programme.desc: Singlarna och exen återförenas för första gången sen den sista dyrkceremonin. Programledare är Jared Haibon och vi får veta vilka par som fortfarande är i smekmånadsstadiet, vilka som gjort slut och vilka som nu delar säng med sina ex.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Celeb Surprises
programme.desc: Åtta heta kärlekstörstande kändisar träffas i en villa. Kori ser ett bekant ansikte medan Mike tar sin kändisflört på dejt. Men det kommer fler överraskningar innan det första exet rör upp känslorna!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Love Triangle
programme.desc: Kaz och exet Theo försonas, men hur länge håller det... Kori och Sofie kommer varandra närmare innan KC lägger sig i och Nathan får en uppenbarelse!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: SOS
programme.desc: En ny kändis blir ett hot mot Sofie och Kori. Det är jobbigt för Kaz att bo med Theo. Nathan och Tommy försonas, och Hemlighålet avslöjas till KC:s stora skräck.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Secret Kisses
programme.desc: KC:s ex Michael kommer in från Hemlighålet, och alla golvas av hans ursäkt. Kori och Ella kommer varandra närmare. Theo och KC kysser varandra i hemlighet, men de får sig en överraskning.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Loose Lips
programme.desc: Michael Goonans hemliga uppdrag avslöjas i Hemlighålet, men han har svårt att hålla tungan i styr. Ett ex innebär trubbel för Kori och Ella, och KC får grönt ljus av Kaz.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: True Colours
programme.desc: Michael Goonan skickar hem en deltagare och ifrågasätter sin egen tid i villan. KC har svårt att umgås med Theo medan Kaz är i villan. Nathan tar farväl av sitt ex Tommy, men får ta emot ett annat ex på stranden.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Kori Gets the Hump
programme.desc: Lockie och Megan kysser varandra, Kori blir förvirrad av Sofies blandade signaler, och Nathan är rädd att Declan ska förledas.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Double Whammy
programme.desc: Kori och Lockie får en dubbelsmäll, och det vankas trubbel för kändisarna. Nathans osäkerhet tar över, och Mike får en överraskning!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Theo's 'Down Under' Dilemma
programme.desc: Theo blir förkrossad när Kaz lämnar, och hans relation till KC når sin kulmen. Lockie och Sofie blir ovänner, och ett nytt ex rör om!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Cherry On The Cake
programme.desc: Anya gillar Kori, men har Kori släppt taget om Sofie? En ny kändis uppmärksammas, originalgänget ställs inför ett tufft val, och en pridefest avslöjar en guldskatt vid regnbågens slut.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Going Going Gone!
programme.desc: Ett nyanlänt ex ser ut att fånga Megans uppmärksamhet. Kris bekänner sina känslor för Ella, Kori och Sofie gör upp, och Nathan ställs inför ett svårt val när en i originalgänget ska ut!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Finale!
programme.desc: Ännu ett ex skakar om två av kändisparen. Hemlighålet släpper sin sista bomb, och den sista måltiden medför en stor överraskning! Frågan är, kommer det att sluta lyckligt eller i tårar?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Journey To Engagement
programme.desc: Sex par och deras före detta måste välja: Fria eller gå skilda vägar? Men innan de säger ja, kan de gå vidare från sina ex?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You're Breaking My Heart
programme.desc: Paren gör sig hemmastadda i villan, men semestern tar slut när de första exen checkar in. Liam blir förkrossad över sanningen om Leylah och hennes ex. Det första Hemlighålet ger ögonöppnande sanningar och överraskande gäster.

programme.desc: In this episode, the crew pimps Amber's Chevy Cavalier.
